scope: Round-two complete proposal automated evidence; no manual conformance certification

notes: Three DealPath scenarios passed with zero axe violations and zero uncaught errors: hire-first, client-first and 320px printed terms.

Native Tab/Shift+Tab reach chapter controls without switching modes. A paper link restores reading with focus preserved. Directional settling, mode return after stale focus, held native touch, viewport resize and semantic reading order are covered by the 55-test browser suite.

Both routes pass automated axe in ordinary reading. A phone rate scene retains its complete associated heading and terms. Accessible content is no longer toggled inert/hidden by camera progress. These scans are not complete conformance certification.
The complete flyer and linked proposal notes remain readable without JavaScript; no canvas fallback is needed.
Normal reading and notes have no horizontal overflow. Every complete camera group is tested at 1440×1000, 320×740, 390×844, 430×932 and 390×664; phones DPR3.

Independent design/commercial review accepted the complete round-two composition at desktop, phone, small and short sizes after rejected iterations. Primary text bounds, measured header/control insets and minimum rendered size are tested separately.
VoiceOver review was not performed. Semantic HTML, axe and keyboard checks are not screen-reader-equivalent manual proof.
Native Chromium touch dispatch verifies held contact and actual browser scroll. Physical iOS/Android devices, notched-screen behavior and the reported iPhone crash remain unverified.
Viewport reflow is tested. Manual text resizing, browser zoom and forced-colors coverage are not claimed.
